{
  "subject_template": "Early Payment Offer for {INVOICE_NO} with {VENDOR}",
  "body_template": "Dear {VENDOR},

We hope this message finds you well. We are pleased to offer you a {DISC_PCT} discount on your invoice {INVOICE_NO} if payment is made by {PAY_BY}. This will save you {SAVINGS} and allow for instant payment via RTP to your bank account. Please note that payment is due within {NET_DAYS} days from the invoice date. We look forward to your prompt response.

Best regards,
Accounts Payable"
}
